description: An efficient and proactive budgeting web app that tracks daily expenses, shows remaining monthly amount and daily safe-to-spend limit, interactive category spending charts, recent expenses list, and local device persistence with a calm light financial dashboard.

layouts.mobile_container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#F4F7F4] text-[#1B2A22] shadow-2xl relative overflow-x-hidden pb-24
layouts.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#D8E6DC] px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between

accessibility.contrast_target: WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum for body text)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a responsive mobile-first budgeting web app with local storage persistence. Key features: 1) Monthly budget setup & optional category limits; 2) Quick expense entry with amount, category, note, date, payment method; 3) Remaining monthly amount & daily safe-to-spend calculation; 4) Interactive category spending breakdown chart (using recharts); 5) Recent expenses list with search/filter & delete/edit; 6) Calm light aesthetic (#F4F7F4 bg, #2D6A4F forest green primary, #52B788 accent). Ensure all interactive elements include data-testid attributes for testing.
universal_guidelines: Never use pure black or pure white without tinting
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive and key informational elements
Mobile-first design optimized for mobile web app viewing
